_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. Search-first: what someone would actually type, never 'Course 4'. One entry per course in src/content/index.ts. Terraform is named wherever the course really teaches it — that, and the one shop being built across all 12, is what separates this series from aws-ct's.
intro: AWS for Beginners: What We'll Build, Renting Against Owning Servers, and the Whole Architecture
how-aws-runs: How AWS Works: Regions and Availability Zones, Every Action an API Call, SigV4 Signing, ARNs and What Costs Money
start: Terraform on AWS for Beginners: Profiles and Sessions, init/plan/apply, State and Drift, an S3 Backend, Tags and a Budget
secure: AWS IAM Explained: Roles and Trust Policies, Temporary Credentials, Policy Evaluation, Resource Policies, Two Accounts and SCPs
network: AWS VPC Explained: CIDR and Subnets, Route Tables, Internet and NAT Gateways, Security Groups against NACLs, a Load Balancer, Route 53, ACM and Endpoints
run: Run a Container App on AWS: Docker Images and ECR, ECS Fargate Task Definitions, Task Roles, Auto Scaling, Graceful Shutdown and EC2
data: AWS Data Stores Explained: S3 Versioning and Presigned URLs, RDS PostgreSQL Multi-AZ, Transactions, Secrets Manager, DynamoDB and Caching
decouple: AWS Messaging Explained: SQS and Dead-Letter Queues, Lambda Consumers, SNS Fan-out, EventBridge Rules, Step Functions and Idempotency
deliver: Terraform in Production: Modules, Two Accounts, a GitHub Actions Pipeline, OIDC Roles, Drift and Import, Replacement and Safe Releases
report: Build a Data Lake on AWS with Terraform: Parquet Partitions, a Glue Catalog, Athena Queries, Kinesis Streams, and Lake Against Warehouse
operate: Operating on AWS: Logs, Metrics and Traces, SLOs and Burn-Rate Alarms, CloudTrail, KMS Envelope Encryption, WAF, Backups, an Incident and DR
evolve: AWS Cost and Performance: CloudFront Caching, Finding the Knee, the Month's Bill, Cost Allocation Tags, a Decision Record and Well-Architected
